cacheTtlSeconds.description: How long API responses are cached in the backend

enableSecureSocksProxy.description: Route requests through Grafana Cloud Private Data Source Connect (PDC) to reach n8n on a private network

maxPages.description: Upper limit of API pages (250 executions each) fetched per query

tlsAuthWithCACert.description: Verify the server certificate against a custom CA (e.g. internal PKI)

url.description: Base URL of the n8n public API, including /api/v1. n8n Cloud: https://<instance>.app.n8n.cloud/api/v1, self-hosted: http://<host>:5678/api/v1

secureValues.description: n8n API key (Settings > n8n API), sent as X-N8N-API-KEY header
